title: Safer hand: people first
question: Every card now follows your steer: the student photo leads and stays clear, the BRICKBOT wordmark sits in the hero with the motto below it, Support us is the primary button with Contact us beside it, and the bottom of the hero says Focșani, Romania and top 10 in the world last season. Everything is set in Anek Latin. The worlds differ in the material around the photo. Open a card's expand chip to see its sketch at full size.

options.label: Arena Lights
options.lineage: competition-arena night: LED perimeter boards, floodlit crowds, broadcast tickers
options.thesis: The hero is the arena at the moment of the win: the full-bleed crowd photo, and below it an LED perimeter board scrolling Focșani, Romania and Top 10 in the world, the kind of board sponsors already pay to be on.
materials: dot-matrix LED board with a bolt-notched top edge
one live arc along the board
Anek Latin Condensed on the LEDs, Expanded for headings
options.viewport: Full-bleed Nationals photo with a soft dark scrim only at the lower left; the wordmark, motto and two buttons sit there; an LED board across the bottom scrolls “Focșani, Romania ⚡ Top 10 in the world · 2025–26 ⚡ FTC team #15996”.
options.risk: Ticker bands are common on sports sites; the LED board has to be crafted properly (real dot matrix, pausable) or it reads as cheap.

options.label: Team Kit
options.lineage: the team's own yellow jerseys: raglan panel curves, sublimated patterns, piping and the woven hem tag
options.thesis: The site wears the team's kit: a black side panel curves into the photo like a jersey seam with yellow and burgundy piping, and a yellow hem band at the bottom carries the facts like a woven tag.
options.viewport: The photo fills the right two-thirds untouched; a black panel with a curved seam edge holds the wordmark, motto and buttons on the left; a yellow hem band across the bottom reads “Made in Focșani, Romania · Top 10 in the world · 2025–26 season · FTC #15996”.
options.risk: The seam curve is the whole idea; if it's drawn timidly it's just a split hero.

options.label: Sticker Bomb
options.lineage: die-cut vinyl stickers on a laptop or robot case, kiss-cut white borders
options.thesis: Everything is a die-cut sticker: the photo is one big sticker with a white kiss-cut border and a custom-cut corner, the wordmark is a sticker, and the facts are a row of pill stickers. Lightning arrives as a bolt sticker.
options.viewport: The photo as a large tilted sticker on the right; the wordmark sticker, motto and buttons on the left; a round “Top 10 in the world” sticker on the photo's corner (off the faces); a row of pill stickers at the bottom: Focșani, Romania · Top 10 in the world, 2025–26 · FTC team #15996.
options.risk: The most playful card: it can tip into teen clutter, and sponsors may read it as less serious.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Played straight at the craft of landonorris.com, McLaren Racing and Red Bull Racing: full-bleed photo, name and motto at the bottom, buttons, a thin fact bar.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed photo, the wordmark and motto lower left, buttons lower right, a hairline bar at the bottom with Focșani, Romania and Top 10 in the world.
canonCard.risk: Familiar by design: personality has to come from motion and the sections below.
